source.title: Rubik's Cube® to sponsor the 2022 World Cube Association Continental Championships
source.content:
RUBIK'S CUBE®, owned by Spin Master, a leading global children's entertainment company, has announced an unprecedented sponsorship with the World Cube Association (WCA). Since its release in the late '70s, the Rubik's Cube - from its Hungarian inventor Professor Ernő Rubik - has fascinated millions of people around the world. The complexity coupled with the colorful patterns led to the Rubik's Cube's immense popularity and presence in pop culture. Naturally, with the development of methods to solve the puzzle more efficiently, came a strong desire for competition. The first international gathering took place in 1982 in [Budapest](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WC1982) in which the American [Minh Thai](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/1982THAI01) took the victory and set the first ever official World Record with a result of 22.95 seconds. 
 
 After a break of more than 20 years and the advent of internet forums, a passionate group of Cubers decided to revive the competitive spirit of the puzzle and organized the [2003 World Championship](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WC2003) in Toronto, Canada. This competition was a massive success and prompted multiple smaller scale competitions to be organized in Europe and the USA. In August 2004, the World Cube Association (WCA) was created by the Dutchman Ron van Bruchem and the American Tyson Mao. The goal was to track records, define a uniform set of rules, and help with the organization of more competitions in more countries. The WCA has now officiated more than 7,000 competitions in 143 countries, with more than 150,000 unique participants. Since Minh Thai's record in 1982, the 3x3 Cube World Record has lowered significantly and now stands at [3.47 seconds](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/records) set by the Chinese [Yusheng Du](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2015DUYU01) in 2018.
 
 The sponsorship will deliver the following six Rubik's WCA Continental Championships in 2022:
 
 - Rubik's WCA African Championship 2022 - Cape Town, South Africa - Dates TBC
 - Rubik's WCA Asian Championship 2022 - TBC
 - Rubik's WCA European Championship 2022 - Copenhagen, Denmark - 14th - 17th July, 2022
 - Rubik's WCA North American Championship 2022 - Toronto, Canada - 7th - 10th July, 2022
 - Rubik's WCA Oceanic Championship 2022 - Melbourne, Australia - 15th - 18th December, 2022 
 - Rubik's WCA South American Championship 2022 - Brasília, Brazil - 22nd - 24th July, 2022
 
 RUBIK'S CUBE® and the WCA have a shared goal of bringing together communities of problem-solvers and the best experience for fun, fair and professional competitions.

translation.title: Rubik’s Cube® 将赞助 2022 年 WCA 大洲锦标赛
translation.content:
全球知名儿童娱乐公司 Spin Master 旗下的 RUBIK'S CUBE® 宣布与世界魔方协会（WCA）达成一项前所未有的赞助合作。自 20 世纪 70 年代末上市以来，匈牙利发明家 Ernő Rubik 教授创造的魔方吸引了全球数百万人。复杂的结构和缤纷的图案让魔方广受欢迎，也成为流行文化的一部分。随着更高效的解法出现，大家自然开始渴望竞技。首次国际比赛于 1982 年在[布达佩斯](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WC1982)举行，美国选手 [Minh Thai](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/1982THAI01)夺冠，并以 22.95 秒创造了首个官方世界纪录。

间隔二十多年后，随着网络论坛兴起，一群热爱魔方的人决定重拾魔方竞技，在加拿大多伦多举办了 [2003 年世锦赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WC2003)。比赛大获成功，随后欧洲和美国陆续举办了多场较小规模的比赛。2004 年 8 月，荷兰人 Ron van Bruchem 和美国人 Tyson Mao 创建了世界魔方协会（WCA），目的是记录成绩、制定统一规则，并帮助更多国家举办更多比赛。如今，WCA 已在 143 个国家认证了超过 7,000 场比赛，参赛人数超过 150,000 人。自 Minh Thai 于 1982 年创造纪录以来，三阶世界纪录已大幅缩短，目前为中国选手[杜宇生](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/persons/2015DUYU01)在 2018 年创造的 [3.47 秒](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/records)。

此次赞助将支持以下六场 2022 年 Rubik’s WCA 大洲锦标赛：

* Rubik’s WCA 2022 非洲锦标赛——南非开普敦，日期待定。
* Rubik’s WCA 2022 亚洲锦标赛——待定。
* Rubik’s WCA 2022 欧洲锦标赛——丹麦哥本哈根，2022 年 7 月 14–17 日。
* Rubik’s WCA 2022 北美锦标赛——加拿大多伦多，2022 年 7 月 7–10 日。
* Rubik’s WCA 2022 大洋洲锦标赛——澳大利亚墨尔本，2022 年 12 月 15–18 日。
* Rubik’s WCA 2022 南美锦标赛——巴西巴西利亚，2022 年 7 月 22–24 日。

RUBIK'S CUBE® 与 WCA 有着共同的目标：让热爱解谜的人们相聚，提供有趣、公平、专业的最佳参赛体验。
